description: The file defines the OAuthClientAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing OAuth clients within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting OAuth client records, with associated validation rules and documentation annotations.

classes.name: OAuthClientAPI
classes.description: A REST API class providing CRUD operations for OAuth clients in OrangeHRM, with documentation annotations for OpenAPI (Swagger) integration.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of OAuth clients with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new OAuth client, generating a secret if confidential.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes OAuth clients based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific OAuth client by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing OAuth client, managing secret regeneration if the confidentiality status changes.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the list retrieval endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new OAuth client.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting OAuth clients.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single OAuth client.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an OAuth client.

methods.name: setOAuthClient
methods.description: Sets OAuth client properties from request parameters.

methods.name: generateSecret
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure secret for OAuth clients.
